name: mail
title: Mail
description: Transactional email for Lunora — a sendEmail action (plus a fire-and-forget queueEmail) built on @lunora/mail's Cloudflare Email Workers transport, with CR/LF + header-injection-safe address handling and a dev mail catcher that surfaces every send in the studio.
docs: Default provider is Cloudflare Email Workers (the SEND_EMAIL send binding). `lunora init` / `lunora add email` prompt for the verified destination address (or pass `--mail-to`); the low-level `lunora registry add mail` writes the `destination_address` placeholder — set up Email Routing, verify the address, and replace it in wrangler.jsonc. Set MAIL_FROM in your env/.dev.vars and re-export from lunora/index.ts so codegen emits api.mail.sendEmail. In `lunora dev` every send is captured into the studio's Mail tab instead of delivered (no provider setup needed) — set LUNORA_MAIL_CAPTURE=0 to deliver in dev, or =1 to force capture. Prefer a hosted provider? Pass `apiKey` (Resend) or a custom `transport` to createMailer in lunora/mail/index.ts. queueEmail needs a Cloudflare Queue binding — see the README before enabling it.

envVars.name: MAIL_FROM
envVars.description: Default sender address. Use a domain you control on Cloudflare Email Routing; `Name <addr@host>` or bare `addr@host`.
